mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee ( department_id, employee_num, login_id, password, employee_name, gender, birth_date, postal_code, road_address, detail_address, profile_img_path ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{employeeNum}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{employeeName}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{postalCode}, #{roadAddress}, #{detailAddress}, #{profileImgPath} )
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, d.department_name, d.department_type FROM employee e JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE e.login_id = #{loginKey} OR e.employee_num = #{loginKey};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE employee_num = #{employeeNum}
